turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I walk to work with my laptop and my current bag is wrecking my shoulder. Help me pick a new one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A leather messenger bag looks really smart for meetings, but it's still one strap on one shoulder.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a waterproof rolltop backpack, very sturdy, but it looks a bit like I'm off hiking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a slim office backpack with a padded laptop sleeve and a luggage strap, kind of middle of the road.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Since your shoulder is the problem, I'd skip the messenger bag, one strap is how you got here. The slim office backpack sounds like the sweet spot, comfortable and still neat. The rolltop is perfect if you get rained on a lot.
